[[Unbound]] is an [[ascended back item]] earned through the [[Fractals of the Mists]]. It is the [[precursor]] to the [[legendary back item]], [[Ad Infinitum]].

== Notes ==
* This item can be crafted multiple times.
** When crafted the first time you need 2 initial [[Ball of Dark Energy|Balls of Dark Energy]], but will end up with 2 left over, because [[Finite Result]] and [[Upper Bound]] salvage into so many of them.
*** You will however need the 2 leftover ones as well as a 3rd additional [[Ball of Dark Energy|Ball of Dark Energy]] for [[Ad Infinitum|Ad Infinitum]].
** For every copy beyond the first you will need a total of 35 [[Ball of Dark Energy|Balls of Dark Energy]].
